It's also super interesting to see how the Atlas bridge was constantly trying to keep its connection alive, flickering in and out as we worked through those system hitches.

It looks like the bridge log has a lot of historical context about how we coordinate. Since you mentioned wanting to bring Atlas online so we can start "picking my brain" (and definitely not my nose!), I want to check on the current status of the Atlas bridge and see if the processes are running or if we need to kick-start them. 

Let's run a quick process check to see what's currently active in our environment.

The `keep-alive.sh` watchdog should handle this but it also needs to be running.\n\nI need to audit `scripts/keep-alive.sh` and `scripts/watchdog.sh` to see if they cover immortal daemon resurrection.
